title: Reading Drill — Planning a safer route from a nursery — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning a safer route from a nursery — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The nursery manager in Elmbrook received an old report about parents with prams sharing a narrow doorway with deliveries. The report compared obstructions at opening time, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the caretaker logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include late food orders. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a separate delivery period as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
